definitions.full: H8368. sathar [ שָׂתַר ] verb Niph`al burst or break out , of tumours (Arabic have inverted , or cracked, eyelids , or lower lips ; Ethiopic lacerate ; Assyrian [ šatâru ] II. tear down ; Syriac destroy , so Sabean שתר SabDenkm No. 48, 1. 2 , Biblical Aramaic סְתַר Ezra 5:12 ); — Niph`al Imperfect עפלים לָהֶם וַיִּשָּֽׂתְרוּ 1Sam 5:9 and tumours brake out to them.
